library.title: Library
library.emptyBody: Install a .zip wallpaper, or pick an installed mod and set it as your wallpaper.
library.emptyHint: Install or pick a mod to get started.
library.installSoon: Install a wallpaper from a .zip file.
library.removeConfirm: Remove this wallpaper? Its mod folder will be deleted.
library.importFolderHint: Copy an unpacked wallpaper folder into the library.
library.installDone: Installed. The library has been updated.
library.keyboardHint: Arrow keys to browse, Enter for details, Ctrl+click to multi-select, Ctrl+A select all, Ctrl+D clear
library.addImageHint: Use a PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or BMP file as a wallpaper.
library.detailEmpty: Select a wallpaper below to see its details.
library.restoreDefaultsHint: Forget which defaults were applied to this wallpaper so the next load seeds them again (per screen).
library.removeConfirmHint: The wallpaper files are deleted from the wallpapers folder. This cannot be undone.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage language, startup and rendering behavior.

showDesktopIcons.title: Show desktop icons
showDesktopIcons.desc: Toggle Windows desktop icons. The wallpaper stays behind them.

openFolder.title: Wallpapers folder
openFolder.desc: Open the folder that holds images, web wallpapers and mods.

pauseFullscreen.title: Pause on fullscreen
pauseFullscreen.desc: Stop rendering wallpapers when a game or video is fullscreen.

enableGpu.title: Hardware acceleration
enableGpu.desc: Use the GPU for wallpaper rendering. Takes effect after restart.

startWithWindows.title: Start with Windows
startWithWindows.desc: Starts at sign-in with only a tray icon; the main window stays hidden.

memorySaver.title: Memory saver
memorySaver.desc: Suspend the Octos main UI when hidden in the tray.

maxFps.title: Wallpaper frame rate
maxFps.desc: Cap animation frame rate to save CPU and GPU. Applies immediately.

muteWallpapers.title: Mute wallpapers
muteWallpapers.desc: Silence audio from every wallpaper page. Applies immediately.

communitySource.title: Community catalog URL
communitySource.desc: Leave empty for the built-in catalog. A jsDelivr mirror works when GitHub raw is slow.

webDefaults.title: Web wallpaper defaults
webDefaults.desc: Seed these values once into every old-style web wallpaper. Values you tune per screen in the wallpaper panel are kept; defaults are only rewritten when they change.
webDefaults.fieldsDesc: Position and scale are saved per screen by the wallpaper panel and are never set here.

playlist.emptyHint: Import wallpapers to set up automatic rotation here.
playlist.overrideHint: Rotation is on; the next change will override a manual pick.

status.needTwo: Add at least two wallpapers to rotate

order.title: Order
order.hint: Queue order follows the list on the right; random never repeats back to back.

playlist.queueEmpty: Queue is empty. Use the + button on a wallpaper card to add it.

community.title: Community
community.emptyBody: Refresh the catalog, or check the community URL in Settings.
community.noResultsBody: Try a different search or tag.
community.filesTruncated: The archive contains more files than shown.

error.network: Network error while contacting the community catalog.
error.http-status: The community server returned an error.
error.rate-limited: GitHub is rate limiting downloads. Try again later.
error.hash-mismatch: The downloaded file failed its SHA-256 check.
error.size-mismatch: The downloaded file has the wrong size.
error.too-large: The download is larger than the allowed limit.
error.locked: The wallpaper folder is in use. Switch another wallpaper first, then retry.
error.app-too-old: This wallpaper requires a newer Octocaris version.
error.unknown-item: This wallpaper is not in the catalog anymore. Refresh it.
